title: Suspected low blood sugar
whenToUse: A crewmate is shaky, confused, sweaty or sluggish and may have low blood sugar.

steps.text: Check if the crewmate is awake and able to swallow safely.
steps.caution: If unresponsive or unable to swallow safely, give nothing by mouth.

steps.text: Give oral glucose only if they are awake and able to swallow.
steps.detail: Use measured glucose tablets or gel from the crew medical kit if available.

steps.text: If they cannot swallow safely, alert the medical officer immediately for care.
Wait 15 minutes, then recheck alertness and symptoms.

redFlags: The crewmate becomes drowsy, confused or unresponsive.
Symptoms do not improve 15 minutes after oral glucose.

escalation.text: Red flag or getting worse? Alert a crewmate now. Do not wait for Earth.
